main_body: tree with rounded canopy, straight trunk, and elliptical ground shadow
top_band: rounded canopy lobes (rows 1-31) with bottom-up shading, and an elliptical ground base (rows 38-43)
evidence: Organic tree shown in 3/4 view with overlapping canopy puffs and a vertical trunk (rows 33-42) planted on a foreshortened elliptical grass shadow (rows 38-43). Notably, the canopy puffs are shaded upside-down (dark on top at rows 1-6 and 16-20, light at the bottom at rows 10-13 and 26-31), contradicting top-down lighting, though the overall silhouette and ground ellipse establish a 3/4 view.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees which have rich individual leaf cluster textures, gnarled roots, and soft dark-green material outlines, the candidate is drawn like a flat cartoon sticker. It has a heavy continuous near-black outline around smooth, pillow-shaded blobs with no leaf texture, an upside-down gradient on each blob, and a straight 5px-wide geometric column for a trunk.
